column1: Recommended architecture: deterministic scientific state + reusable SVG/web scenes + selective specialist rendering. HyperFrames is the production candidate; the shipped proof uses native SVG/CairoSVG/FFmpeg, not HyperFrames.

Do not confuse machine expense with total production cost. The prototype has no separate cloud invoice; its measured local wall time is not a cloud price or a forecast for 10-minute narrated lessons. Prices checked 13 October 2026. Taxes, viewer delivery, legal costs, hardware purchase and royalties are outside this production model.
